content.application_contract: Apply only when the independent scene explicitly names at least two existing visible owners and positively declares their viewer-attention order or unequal visual prominence. Use exactly that declared owner assignment and ordering; preserve their count, identities, actions, connections and physical arrangement. For a declared dominant/supporting pair use only those two levels; do not invent a third. Do not infer viewer order from a character’s gaze, social or shipping priority, quoted inscription, foreground distance, light location, a title, or negated dominance. Equal-weight requests do not satisfy this prerequisite. Do not add a source, owner, causal event, lighting scheme, camera setup or placement rule. Missing or ambiguous owner/order declarations require review; this prose supplies no native binding proof.
content.definition: The whole photograph carries an explicitly declared ordered prominence relation over two or more existing visible owners, including existing object, person, body-region, interaction or background owners. Adjacent nominated levels preserve their declared earlier/later relationship; unspecified owners receive no invented position. Readability remains required at every nominated level.
content.en: Within one photograph, attention follows the independently declared order among already identified visible owners. Each nominated owner remains recognizable; an earlier owner receives greater visual prominence than the next, while later owners stay readable without competing ahead of it. Preserve that order when an object or interaction precedes a face, and when only two levels are declared. This sequence belongs to photographic presentation, without changing the owners’ actions, physical arrangement, identities or causal relationships.
content.ko: 한 사진 안에서 주의는 이미 식별된 보이는 대상들 사이에 독립적으로 지정된 순서를 따른다. 지정된 각 대상은 알아볼 수 있게 유지하며, 앞선 대상은 다음 대상보다 시각적으로 더 두드러지고 뒤의 대상은 그보다 먼저 시선을 끌지 않으면서 읽을 수 있게 남는다. 사물이나 상호작용이 얼굴보다 앞서는 경우와 두 단계만 지정된 경우에도 그 순서를 보존한다. 이 순서는 사진의 표현에 속하며 대상들의 행동, 물리적 배치, 정체나 인과 관계를 바꾸지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Instantiate only supplied information classes; none is mandatory merely because it appears in the option. Preserve the exact supplied event history without requiring unprovided dates, and preserve the full declared status subtype rather than replacing it with another status. Every quote remains attributed to its supplied reporting source. Capture date refers only to capture, not publication date. Image creator, supplier, depicted participant and statement source remain distinct owners unless independently identified as the same. Retain unknown or disputed attribution and date states. Do not invent facts, infer names or history from visible appearance, grant publication rights, add an unprovided status, or convert external caption information into pixel lettering, a watermark, a prop label or image-plane layout.
content.definition: A publication-owned relationship separates observed image content from independently supplied contextual statements and image metadata, retaining each statement source, declared status subtype, uncertainty and attribution owner outside the photograph pixels.
content.en: An external publication caption distinguishes visible content from independently supplied context about the photograph. It may describe depicted actions and established roles, report a supplied event history, or state declared archive, illustrative or staged status. Supplied location and capture date retain their exact scope; quoted explanations identify their reporting source. Creator or supplier credit concerns the image, not depicted-person identity. Uncertainty stays explicit, including unknown dates or disputed authorship. Only information actually supplied is instantiated; none becomes visible lettering or proof inferred from appearance.
content.ko: 외부 게재 캡션이 보이는 내용과 사진에 관해 독립적으로 제공된 맥락을 구별한다. 캡션은 묘사된 행동과 확립된 역할을 설명하거나, 제공된 사건 이력을 전하거나, 명시된 자료·예시·연출 사진 지위를 밝힐 수 있다. 제공된 장소와 촬영일은 정확한 적용 범위를 유지하고 인용 설명은 취재 출처를 명시한다. 제작자나 공급자 크레디트는 사진 자체에 관한 것이며 피사체의 신원이 아니다. 알 수 없는 날짜나 논쟁 중인 저자 귀속을 포함한 불확실성은 명시적으로 남긴다. 실제로 제공된 정보만 구체화하며 어느 정보도 보이는 글자나 외양에서 추론한 증거로 바꾸지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Use only when the independent frozen source identifies the existing nonhuman object or its explicitly owned part and supplies the complete relevant declaration. Resolve exact actual carrier and scope, including contents or assembly basis and stated conditions. This generic target creates no carrier, part, human target, value or declaration. Preserve source claim status; no image-based measurement, scale event, force conversion, accuracy or certification follows. Missing or ambiguous source, ownership or permission keeps this discovery-only. All actual material/physical.mass effects, preservation duties, receivers and property/dimension locks remain cumulative; equal-value retention is still an effect. This prose supplies no native proof or arbitrary-value condition validation. Additionally require an affirmative literal physical heaviness/lightness declaration. Preserve only the stated polarity. Negation, quoted lettering, visual balance, emotional weight or merely heavy/light-looking language cannot activate it.
content.en: An independently identified existing object retains its explicitly declared physical heaviness or lightness on that same carrier. Preserve the source’s qualitative wording and exact whole-object or owned-part scope, without assigning a numerical mass, comparison reference or measurement status. Material appearance, dimensions, drape, support and handling remain separately specified; they do not establish the declaration.
content.ko: 독립적으로 식별된 기존 물체는 같은 대상에 명시적으로 선언된 물리적 무거움이나 가벼움을 유지한다. 수치 질량이나 비교 기준, 측정 상태를 부여하지 않고 원문의 질적 표현과 정확한 전체 물체 또는 소유 부위 범위를 보존한다. 재료의 외관, 크기, 드레이프, 지지와 취급은 별도로 지정되며 이 선언의 근거가 되지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Require the actor, opening, action and illumination to be independently established. Preserve actual owner, event phase and setting. This source may carry only the requester’s declared emotional reading; it makes no universal claim that an opening or warm light means hope. It does not change a shop into a home, add a visitor, prescribe a facial expression or assert success.
content.definition: An independently established actor remains at an existing opening between two readable spatial zones. The opening, the actor’s current action and the light falling within or across the boundary stay visible together. The requested emotional atmosphere is an interpretation of this complete arrangement, not proof of the actor’s belief or what happens next. Keep the declared opening action and actual place; do not substitute closure, departure, a smile or another person’s arrival.
content.en: An independently established actor remains at an existing opening between two readable spatial zones. The opening, the actor’s current action and the light falling within or across the boundary stay visible together. The requested emotional atmosphere is an interpretation of this complete arrangement, not proof of the actor’s belief or what happens next. Keep the declared opening action and actual place; do not substitute closure, departure, a smile or another person’s arrival.
content.ko: 독립적으로 설정된 인물이 두 공간 영역 사이의 기존 개구부에 머문다. 개구부·인물의 현재 행동·경계 안이나 경계를 가로질러 드는 빛을 함께 볼 수 있다. 요청된 정서적 분위기는 이 완전한 배치에 대한 해석이며 인물의 믿음이나 다음에 일어날 일을 입증하지 않는다. 명시된 여는 동작과 실제 장소를 유지하며 닫기·출발·미소나 다른 사람의 도착으로 대체하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires one independently present handled vessel, its own support dish, supporting surface, named actor and designated hand. Preserve vessel/dish identity and existing object state, actor posture and setting. The declared hand fixes direction, not permission to move it. Do not substitute screen-right, another actor’s hand, a gripping action, a pouring event or a new support.
content.definition: An existing handled vessel rests on its own already declared support dish, with its base visibly contacting that dish. The dish’s base contacts the existing surface beside the named actor. The handle projects toward the independently specified hand of that same actor. The hand’s anatomical side follows the scene declaration rather than the photograph’s left or right. The actor need not grip the handle, and the nested support contacts remain visible.
content.en: An existing handled vessel rests on its own already declared support dish, with its base visibly contacting that dish. The dish’s base contacts the existing surface beside the named actor. The handle projects toward the independently specified hand of that same actor. The hand’s anatomical side follows the scene declaration rather than the photograph’s left or right. The actor need not grip the handle, and the nested support contacts remain visible.
content.ko: 기존 손잡이 용기의 밑면이 그 용기의 이미 선언된 받침 접시에 닿아 놓인다. 접시의 밑면은 지정된 인물 옆에서 기존 표면에 닿는다. 손잡이는 같은 인물의 독립적으로 지정된 손을 향해 돌출된다. 손의 신체 좌우는 사진의 왼쪽이나 오른쪽이 아니라 장면 선언을 따른다. 인물이 손잡이를 잡을 필요는 없고 겹친 받침 접촉 관계가 보이게 유지된다.

content.application_contract: Requires an independently declared bird and existing selected wing. Preserve species, pose, wing number and current degree of fold; no universal joint angle, bone visibility, flight capacity or flight event follows. A costume harness, decorative wing, fantasy extra appendage or human arm cannot serve as this biological owner. A depicted bird requires separately declared representation scope.
content.definition: One declared bird owns the selected shoulder-to-elbow-to-wrist-to-outer-wing chain, retaining whichever wing configuration the independent scene declares.
content.en: The selected wing of the declared bird forms a continuous owned limb. Its base belongs to that bird’s shoulder; the upper wing continues through its elbow into the forewing and through the wrist into the outer wing. Visible folds remain changes of direction along that same wing, with its joined segments kept distinct from the bird’s other wing.
content.ko: 선언된 새의 선택된 날개는 한 주체에 속한 연속된 사지를 이룬다. 날개 밑동은 그 새의 어깨에 속하고 위쪽 날개는 팔꿈치를 거쳐 아래쪽 날개로, 손목관절을 거쳐 바깥쪽 날개로 이어진다. 보이는 접힘은 같은 날개 경로의 방향 변화로 유지되며 이어진 분절들은 새의 반대쪽 날개와 구별된다.

content.application_contract: Apply only to an existing drawer cabinet whose runner supports are visibly evidenced. Preserve the declared drawer count and each drawer-to-carcass relationship. An open drawer alone does not prove rails. Do not add a worker, tools, installation event, concealed joinery, soft-close mechanism, exact extension state or material.
content.definition: A drawer cabinet has a bounded carcass with side panels, a top and a base. Each already declared drawer remains a separate box with its own front panel. Paired runner members extend between that drawer and the inside of the cabinet, defining its supported sliding route while remaining distinct from the drawer front and outer carcass edges.
content.en: A drawer cabinet has a bounded carcass with side panels, a top and a base. Each already declared drawer remains a separate box with its own front panel. Paired runner members extend between that drawer and the inside of the cabinet, defining its supported sliding route while remaining distinct from the drawer front and outer carcass edges.
content.ko: 서랍 수납장에는 옆판·윗판·밑판으로 경계가 이루어진 몸체가 있다. 이미 선언된 각 서랍은 자기 앞판이 있는 별도의 상자 형태를 유지한다. 짝을 이루는 레일 부재가 그 서랍과 수납장 안쪽 사이에 이어져 지지된 이동 경로를 형성하며, 서랍 앞판 및 바깥 몸체 가장자리와 구별된다.

content.application_contract: Use on an already declared human eye only when round pupil geometry and the local pupil/iris boundary are open or explicitly requested. Preserve established iris color and actor-relative left/right assignment, eye count, gaze, expression and cosmetics. This changes only the stated round pupil geometry and boundary readability; it supplies no new iris pattern, diagnosis, age, ancestry, personality, emotional state, contact lens or biometric identity.
content.definition: A round dark pupil remains a distinct opening within the same already declared human eye’s colored iris while preserving that iris’s independently established base color.
content.en: The already declared human eye shows a round dark pupil as a separate central opening within the colored iris. A clear local boundary distinguishes that opening from the surrounding iris surface, whose established base color remains visible around it. The pupil and iris belong to the same existing eye, with the surrounding eye white occupying its own outer region.
content.ko: 이미 선언된 사람의 눈에서 둥글고 어두운 동공이 유색 홍채 안의 별도 중앙 구멍으로 보인다. 또렷한 국소 경계가 이 구멍과 주변 홍채 표면을 구분하고 그 둘레로 기존 홍채 바탕색이 드러난다. 동공과 홍채는 기존의 같은 눈에 속하며 주변 흰자위는 바깥쪽의 별도 영역을 차지한다.

content.application_contract: Use only when the independent frozen source identifies the existing nonhuman object or its explicitly owned part and supplies the complete relevant declaration. Resolve exact actual carrier and scope, including contents or assembly basis and stated conditions. This generic target creates no carrier, part, human target, value or declaration. Preserve source claim status; no image-based measurement, scale event, force conversion, accuracy or certification follows. Missing or ambiguous source, ownership or permission keeps this discovery-only. All actual material/physical.mass effects, preservation duties, receivers and property/dimension locks remain cumulative; equal-value retention is still an effect. This prose supplies no native proof or arbitrary-value condition validation. Additionally require both independently present nonhuman endpoints and the exact explicit direction and comparison basis. Resolve both actual effect receivers; do not infer an endpoint, substitute an example, reverse the relation or add a comparison from apparent size.
content.en: Two independently identified existing carriers retain their explicitly declared physical mass comparison. Preserve which carrier is lighter or heavier, both grounded endpoints, their exact whole-object or owned-part scopes, the stated comparison basis and conditions. The relation provides no absolute mass, numeric ratio, material density, size relation or visible weighing event. Each carrier remains the same object or part independently supplied by the scene.
content.ko: 독립적으로 식별된 기존 두 대상은 명시적으로 선언된 물리 질량 비교를 유지한다. 어느 쪽이 더 가볍거나 무거운지, 근거가 있는 양쪽 대상과 정확한 전체 물체 또는 소유 부위 범위, 명시된 비교 기준과 조건을 보존한다. 이 관계는 절대 질량이나 수치 비율, 재료 밀도, 크기 관계, 보이는 계량 사건을 제공하지 않는다. 각 대상은 장면에 독립적으로 주어진 동일한 물체나 부위로 남는다.

content.application_contract: Use only when the independent scene explicitly identifies a human skin owner, skin region, decorative motif and cosmetic/body-makeup context. Do not invent a location or motif, move the decoration to another person or garment, replace permanent tattoo meaning, or override a bare-skin/excluded-decoration constraint. Boundaries are visible only within the declared painted area. Preserve every independently declared pigment medium, color, shape, distribution and temporary cosmetic status; a source cannot choose replacements for those supplied traits.
content.definition: An applied decorative cosmetic pigment layer owned by the independently declared human skin region and retaining the independently declared motif.
content.en: Within an explicitly declared body-makeup design, temporary cosmetic pigment forms the independently specified decorative motif on the declared human skin region. Individual painted marks follow that skin surface, with their boundaries and nearby bare skin visible. The motif and its skin location remain exactly those supplied by the scene; the cosmetic layer does not imply a permanent tattoo or decoration on clothing.
content.ko: 명시적으로 선언한 보디 메이크업 디자인 안에서 일시적인 화장용 안료가 선언된 사람의 피부 부위에 독립적으로 지정한 장식 모티프를 이룬다. 개별적으로 그린 자국들은 그 피부 표면을 따르며 경계와 근처 맨피부가 보인다. 모티프와 피부 위치는 장면에서 제공한 그대로 유지된다. 이 화장 층은 영구 문신이나 의복 위 장식을 뜻하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires one independently present elongated prop, a floor, and one existing support object with a specifically declared upper contact region. Preserve all object identities, support orientation and prop state. Never substitute a chair leg for a declared backrest or vice versa. Does not require an umbrella, a folded state, an actor, a ritual staff or a specific material.
content.definition: One existing elongated prop leans along a sloping axis between two distinct contacts. Its lower end meets the existing floor, and a higher portion meets the independently designated structural region of an existing support object. The two contacts belong to that same prop and remain visible without floating gaps. The support keeps its own orientation, and no person or gripping hand supplies either endpoint.
content.en: One existing elongated prop leans along a sloping axis between two distinct contacts. Its lower end meets the existing floor, and a higher portion meets the independently designated structural region of an existing support object. The two contacts belong to that same prop and remain visible without floating gaps. The support keeps its own orientation, and no person or gripping hand supplies either endpoint.
content.ko: 기존의 길쭉한 소품 하나가 서로 다른 두 접촉점 사이에서 비스듬한 축으로 기대어 있다. 아래쪽 끝은 기존 바닥에 닿고 더 높은 부분은 기존 받침 물건에서 독립적으로 지정된 구조 부위에 닿는다. 두 접촉점은 같은 소품에 속하며 떠 있는 틈 없이 보인다. 받침 물건 자체의 방향은 유지하고 사람이나 소품을 잡는 손이 어느 끝점도 대신 받치지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Use only for declared over-ear headphones with a headband and cup-supporting yokes. Preserve both same-product connections and the actual object count. Do not introduce a wearer, human ears, costume ear shapes, decorative mechanical extensions, audio performance, electronics, cable path, material or a current wearing/holding state.
content.definition: One over-ear headphone assembly has a curved headband spanning between two separately bounded ear cups. At each side, a yoke connects the end of the band to its corresponding cup, keeping the two cup-to-band paths distinct. The band, yokes and cups belong to the same product, without depending on a head or hand to complete their connections.
content.en: One over-ear headphone assembly has a curved headband spanning between two separately bounded ear cups. At each side, a yoke connects the end of the band to its corresponding cup, keeping the two cup-to-band paths distinct. The band, yokes and cups belong to the same product, without depending on a head or hand to complete their connections.
content.ko: 오버이어 헤드폰 하나에는 경계가 구별되는 두 이어컵 사이를 잇는 곡선형 헤드밴드가 있다. 양쪽에서 요크가 밴드의 끝을 각각의 이어컵에 연결하여 두 컵-밴드 경로가 구별된다. 밴드·요크·컵은 같은 제품에 속하며 머리나 손이 연결을 완성할 필요가 없다.

content.application_contract: Use only for a declared articulated desk lamp whose visible members support this arrangement. Preserve its selected base and shade ownership. Do not infer hidden wiring, spring count, manufacture, balance performance, material or illumination from the joint relationship. A one-piece lamp or a wall-only fixture does not acquire this construction.
content.definition: A declared articulated desk lamp has a base supporting a lower arm section. A visible joint links that section to an upper arm section, which carries a separate shade through a short head attachment. The base, arm members, joint and shade remain bounded parts of the same lamp, with their physical connections readable independently of the light beam.
content.en: A declared articulated desk lamp has a base supporting a lower arm section. A visible joint links that section to an upper arm section, which carries a separate shade through a short head attachment. The base, arm members, joint and shade remain bounded parts of the same lamp, with their physical connections readable independently of the light beam.
content.ko: 선언된 관절형 탁상등에서 받침이 아래쪽 팔 구간을 지지한다. 보이는 관절이 이 구간을 위쪽 팔 구간에 연결하고, 위쪽 팔 구간은 짧은 헤드 부착부를 통해 별도의 갓을 지탱한다. 받침·팔 부재·관절·갓은 같은 탁상등에 속하는 경계 있는 부품이며, 빛줄기와 별개로 물리적 연결을 읽을 수 있다.

content.application_contract: Requires an independently declared moving subject and an existing continuous route, with image arrangement open. Preserve their owners, count, action, support and physical path. Existing route curvature may remain while its overall image course is diagonal. Do not infer leftward travel, new action, altered terrain, another person, camera roll or extra scenery. Quoted directional words and another owner’s body-relative left/right are insufficient.
content.definition: The image owns the lower-right position of an existing moving subject and the upper-left continuation of its existing neighboring route; route direction in the frame remains distinct from actor-relative travel direction.
content.en: The independently declared moving subject occupies the lower-right region of a single photograph. An existing continuous route passes beside that subject and extends diagonally across the image toward the upper-left region, keeping the subject-to-route connection readable. The diagonal describes the route through image coordinates; it does not determine the subject’s travel direction, alter the route’s physical structure, or require a tilted camera.
content.ko: 독립적으로 선언된 움직이는 피사체가 한 장의 사진 오른쪽 아래 영역을 차지한다. 기존의 연속된 길은 그 피사체 곁을 지나 화면의 왼쪽 위 영역을 향해 대각선으로 이어져 피사체와 길의 연결이 읽힌다. 대각선은 화면 좌표에서 길이 이어지는 방향을 가리키며 피사체의 이동 방향을 정하거나 길의 물리 구조를 바꾸거나 카메라를 기울일 것을 요구하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Use this optional arrangement only on the independently declared domestic cat when triangular ear contours and a tapering existing tail fit its established form. Preserve its existing breed, coat, color, pose and scene; no universal breed trait, hearing state, mood or transformation is inferred. The physical ear, whisker and tail roots must belong to this same animal. Do not transfer them to a human, costume or another animal.
content.definition: The declared domestic cat carries triangular ear pinnae rooted in its own head and fine whiskers emerging separately from the same muzzle. Its tail joins the rear of that same torso and narrows toward its visible tip. Ear bases, whisker roots and tail base remain parts of one continuous living cat, distinct from detachable costume pieces or painted marks.
content.en: The declared domestic cat carries triangular ear pinnae rooted in its own head and fine whiskers emerging separately from the same muzzle. Its tail joins the rear of that same torso and narrows toward its visible tip. Ear bases, whisker roots and tail base remain parts of one continuous living cat, distinct from detachable costume pieces or painted marks.
content.ko: 선언된 집고양이의 삼각형 귓바퀴는 그 고양이의 머리에 뿌리를 두며 가는 수염은 같은 주둥이에서 개별 가닥으로 나온다. 꼬리는 같은 몸통 뒤에 연결되고 보이는 끝을 향해 가늘어진다. 귀 밑동과 수염 뿌리와 꼬리 밑동은 탈착식 의상 조각이나 그린 자국이 아니라 하나로 이어진 살아 있는 고양이의 부위로 유지된다.

content.application_contract: Use only when the independently declared existing building has the two actual adjacent exterior elevations and their shared outside corner. This controls the capture camera, not any camera depicted inside the scene. A caption, quoted technique name, catalog declaration, body rotation or building label does not supply the physical relation. Preserve building orientation and geometry; do not create a corner, wall, shop, architectural style, lens setting, camera height or distance. Visibility and geometry do not prove exact physical camera calibration or capture history.
content.definition: The capture-camera axis is directed obliquely across the selected existing building’s shared exterior corner; both actual adjoining exterior elevations remain visible within a level-pitch, level-roll view.
content.en: For an existing building with two adjacent exterior elevations, the capture camera looks across their shared outside corner rather than squarely into either elevation. Both wall planes remain visible and recede in different image directions. The viewing axis stays horizontal and the frame roll stays level; the building’s actual wall arrangement and orientation remain independent scene facts.
content.ko: 인접한 두 외벽 입면이 있는 기존 건물에서 촬영 카메라는 어느 한 입면을 정면으로 바라보는 대신 두 면이 공유하는 바깥 모서리를 비껴 바라본다. 두 벽면은 함께 보이며 화면에서 서로 다른 방향으로 멀어진다. 관찰축은 수평이고 프레임의 롤도 수평을 유지한다. 건물의 실제 벽 배치와 방향은 별개의 장면 사실로 보존한다.

content.application_contract: Use only for a declared carabiner whose visible frame and hinged gate support these relationships. Preserve the actual declared open/closed and locking state separately; no locked status, climbing readiness, load rating, certification, specific cross-section or garment owner is inferred. A quoted name, necklace clasp or purely graphic loop does not supply this connector.
content.definition: A declared carabiner has one curved frame surrounding a bounded opening and a separate gate spanning a break in that frame. One end of the gate is attached at a hinge; the other end remains distinguishable from the receiving nose of the frame. Frame, gate, hinge and nose belong to the same discrete connector.
content.en: A declared carabiner has one curved frame surrounding a bounded opening and a separate gate spanning a break in that frame. One end of the gate is attached at a hinge; the other end remains distinguishable from the receiving nose of the frame. Frame, gate, hinge and nose belong to the same discrete connector.
content.ko: 선언된 카라비너에는 경계가 있는 빈 공간을 둘러싼 하나의 곡선형 프레임과 그 프레임의 끊긴 구간을 가로지르는 별도의 게이트가 있다. 게이트의 한쪽 끝은 경첩에 부착되고 반대쪽 끝은 프레임의 받는 노즈와 구별된다. 프레임·게이트·경첩·노즈는 같은 독립된 연결 물체에 속한다.

content.application_contract: Requires an already declared adult and selected existing biological arm. Preserve the independently declared pose, support surfaces, touch targets, handedness and other limbs. Visible external continuity does not establish internal bones, health, force or a hidden endpoint. Do not replace anatomical continuity with a garment, prosthesis or neighbor's arm. This option supplies no new table, bracing, chin contact, raised arm or camera-directed reach.
content.definition: One independently declared adult owns the selected shoulder, upper arm, elbow, forearm, wrist and hand in a continuous route, without selecting a new pose.
content.en: The declared adult’s selected arm retains a single owned anatomical path. The upper arm joins that person at the shoulder and meets the same arm’s forearm at the elbow. The forearm continues through its own wrist into its hand. These junctions remain traceable across the visible contours while the independently declared arm configuration and existing support contacts are retained.
content.ko: 선언된 성인의 선택된 팔은 한 주체에 속한 하나의 해부학적 경로를 유지한다. 위팔은 그 사람의 어깨에 이어지고 팔꿈치에서 같은 팔의 아래팔과 만난다. 아래팔은 자기 손목을 거쳐 자기 손으로 이어진다. 독립적으로 선언된 팔의 구성과 기존 지지 접촉을 유지한 채 보이는 윤곽을 따라 이 연결부들을 확인할 수 있다.

content.application_contract: Requires an independently declared already removed leaf with petiole and its corresponding visible parent-stem endpoint. Preserve the stated cut rather than create a cutting action or infer historical parentage from nearness. Does not add roots, buds, another leaf, plant viability or propagation success. Paper foliage and ornamental seams cannot substitute. Both endpoint owners retain their independent effect locks.
content.definition: The detached leaf owns blade and petiole; its declared former stem endpoint belongs to the independently declared parent plant. The cut interrupts only that declared leaf-to-parent route.
content.en: An already removed botanical leaf retains its own blade joined to its petiole. The free cut end of that petiole is visibly separate from the corresponding declared parent stem, with an open interval between the two endpoints. The leaf’s internal connection and its separation from the parent remain readable as two different relations in the same arrangement.
content.ko: 이미 떼어낸 식물 잎은 자기 잎몸과 잎자루의 연결을 유지한다. 그 잎자루의 자유로운 절단 끝은 해당하는 것으로 선언된 원래 줄기와 눈에 띄게 분리되어 있으며 두 끝점 사이에는 열린 간격이 있다. 잎 내부의 연결과 원래 식물로부터의 분리는 같은 배치에서 서로 다른 두 관계로 읽힌다.

content.application_contract: Use only for an independently declared existing adult human main subject whose hair arrangement, clothing trim and overall presentation are open to change. Keep hair bows on that same wearer and trim on their actual garment. Preserve identity, participant count, facial visibility and every requester lock. Do not infer profession, personality, performer identity, historical rank or gender identity. The arrangement imposes no venue, occasion or new participant. This authored advisory source grants no native adoption or additional owner permission.
content.definition: One existing adult human wearer owns both the arranged hair with attached ribbon bows and the garment bearing repeated ribbon trim. Repeated folded shapes create the cross-component decorative relationship.
content.en: The same adult wearer has hair arranged into several smooth, distinct loops, with narrow ribbon bows fixed at the outer loops. Matching folded ribbons repeat along the garment neckline and sleeve edges, their small knots and separate tails remaining visible. The repeated ornament connects deliberate grooming to dense clothing decoration, producing an elaborate coordinated presentation while the face remains unobscured.
content.ko: 같은 성인 착용자의 머리는 매끈하고 구별되는 여러 고리 형태로 정리되어 바깥 고리에 가느다란 리본 매듭이 고정되어 있다. 같은 접힌 리본이 의복 목둘레와 소매 가장자리를 따라 반복되며 작은 매듭과 분리된 꼬리가 보인다. 반복 장식이 의도적으로 손질한 머리와 밀도 있는 의복 장식을 연결해 정교하게 조율된 화려한 외양을 이루고 얼굴은 가리지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires one independently declared existing focal object, its existing support, and freedom over image placement. Preserve identity, count, shape, color, support and required visibility. The low-detail right field belongs to the existing scene rather than a deleted object or imposed text area. A quoted layout label does not activate this arrangement. This record grants no physical rearrangement or native adoption permission.
content.definition: The image owns a lower-left placement relation for one existing declared object and a contiguous open-field relation on its right; image coordinates do not become an intrinsic property of the object.
content.en: One independently declared focal object occupies the lower-left region of the photograph. A broad, uninterrupted low-detail area remains to its right, with a clear boundary between the object silhouette and the surrounding field. The object remains complete and recognizable on its existing support. This image arrangement uses the quiet right-hand field as negative space without adding a balancing object, inscription, or separate graphic panel.
content.ko: 독립적으로 선언된 주된 물체 하나가 사진의 왼쪽 아래 영역을 차지한다. 그 오른쪽에는 넓고 끊기지 않는 저정보 영역이 남으며 물체 윤곽과 주변 영역의 경계가 분명하다. 물체는 기존 받침 위에서 온전히 알아볼 수 있게 유지된다. 이 화면 배치는 고요한 오른쪽 영역을 네거티브 스페이스로 사용하며 균형을 맞출 추가 물체, 글자 또는 별도의 그래픽 패널을 만들지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Apply only when three existing objects and freedom to arrange their image positions are independently declared. Preserve each identity, count, shape, support relation, required visibility and all frozen placements. This record creates no object, actor, triangle inscription or physical rearrangement permission. Quoted composition labels and publication captions alone do not declare this relation.
content.definition: The image owns a triangular grouping relation among exactly three independently declared existing object owners; the relation concerns their image positions and not any motif printed on a carrier.
content.en: Three separately declared objects occupy three distinct, non-collinear positions in the image, so their visual centers imply a triangular grouping. Each object remains individually recognizable, with visible intervals connecting the group rather than merging its members. The triangle belongs to their relative placement within the photograph; it does not require triangular object shapes, a drawn outline, or additional objects.
content.ko: 따로 선언된 물체 세 개가 화면 안의 서로 다른 비공선 위치를 차지하여 각 물체의 시각적 중심이 삼각 배치를 이룬다. 물체들은 각각 알아볼 수 있고, 서로 합쳐지지 않은 채 눈에 보이는 간격으로 하나의 묶음을 이룬다. 삼각형은 사진 안에서 물체들의 상대 배치에 속하며, 삼각형 모양의 물체나 그려진 윤곽선 또는 추가 물체를 요구하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Use only when the independent scene unambiguously declares an existing carrier and a complete temperature value with its unit. Preserve that exact number, unit, owner and temporal scope. A variable name alone is insufficient. Do not choose a value, convert units, transfer the value to a container or contents, add a thermometer or caption, or infer calibrated measurement from ordinary pixels.
content.definition: Preserve an independently declared temperature number and unit on exactly its declared existing carrier; the carrier may be a solid object or liquid material.
content.en: The identified physical carrier retains the temperature value and unit already supplied by the independent scene. The entire declared number and unit refer to that same object or material at the stated moment, while the photograph keeps the carrier distinguishable from its container and nearby objects.
content.ko: 식별된 물리적 소유 대상이 독립된 장면에서 이미 제시한 온도 수치와 단위를 유지한다. 선언된 수치와 단위 전체는 명시된 순간의 같은 물체 또는 재료를 가리키며, 사진에서는 그 소유 대상이 용기 및 주변 물체와 구별된다.

content.application_contract: Require independently declared scene elements and illumination, not a new participant or an unseen biography. The elements may be people or objects, so an empty prepared room remains empty. Keep a stated lamp, room light or daylight source and all established receiver/action relations. Any mood remains the requester’s contextual reading; shared light alone supplies no particular emotion or social relationship.
content.definition: Two or more independently established scene elements occupy one coherent region of illumination, with its source direction, receiving surfaces and surrounding darker space readable together. Their stated activities and positions remain intact. A requested emotional reading can describe the scene’s shared light and arrangement while leaving every person’s actual feelings unknown. The light does not establish romance, a gathering in progress, a ritual, memory or a particular future outcome.
content.en: Two or more independently established scene elements occupy one coherent region of illumination, with its source direction, receiving surfaces and surrounding darker space readable together. Their stated activities and positions remain intact. A requested emotional reading can describe the scene’s shared light and arrangement while leaving every person’s actual feelings unknown. The light does not establish romance, a gathering in progress, a ritual, memory or a particular future outcome.
content.ko: 독립적으로 설정된 장면 요소 둘 이상이 하나의 일관된 조명 영역에 놓이며 광원 방향·빛을 받는 면·주변의 더 어두운 공간을 함께 읽을 수 있다. 명시된 활동과 위치를 유지한다. 요청된 정서 해석은 장면의 공유된 빛과 배치를 설명할 수 있지만 모든 인물의 실제 감정은 알 수 없는 상태로 둔다. 빛이 연애·진행 중인 모임·의례·기억이나 특정 미래 결과를 입증하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Apply only to a whole existing solid object explicitly declared hot in the independent scene. Do not infer whole-object hotness from a local hot patch, color, glow, lighting or a nearby heat source. Preserve material and phase; do not add fire, tools, burns, melting, optical shimmer, numeric temperature, rate, duration or a heating mechanism.
content.definition: A whole existing solid carrier has explicitly declared physical hotness; no bounded patch is silently expanded to establish whole-object state.
content.en: The existing solid object itself has a declared hot physical temperature at the pictured moment. This thermal state belongs to the identified object as a whole, with its existing solid body and material identity retained. Nearby supports, tools, air and other objects keep their separately stated conditions.
content.ko: 기존 고체 물체 자체가 사진 속 순간에 물리적으로 뜨겁다고 선언된다. 이 열 상태는 식별된 물체 전체에 속하며 기존 고체 몸체와 재료 정체성을 유지한다. 주변 받침, 도구, 공기와 다른 물체는 각각 별도로 명시된 상태를 유지한다.

content.application_contract: Use only for the independently declared common raven animal owner with all named parts on that same body. Keep existing color, pattern, pose and scene; choose a view where the actual roots and specified contours are readable. A quoted name, motif, neighboring animal or costume does not declare the owner. No flight action, emotion, transformation, medical state or additional animal is inferred.
content.definition: On the declared common raven, a heavy bill joins its own feathered face, and shaggy throat feathers continue beneath that same head. Below the connected torso, the tail feathers form a readable wedge outline, with central tips extending farther than the outer tips. Bill, throat and tail remain identifying parts of one bird rather than separate props.
content.en: On the declared common raven, a heavy bill joins its own feathered face, and shaggy throat feathers continue beneath that same head. Below the connected torso, the tail feathers form a readable wedge outline, with central tips extending farther than the outer tips. Bill, throat and tail remain identifying parts of one bird rather than separate props.
content.ko: 선언된 큰까마귀의 굵은 부리는 그 새의 깃털 난 얼굴과 이어지고 같은 머리 아래에는 덥수룩한 목깃이 이어진다. 연결된 몸통 아래에서 꼬리 깃털은 중앙 끝이 바깥 끝보다 더 뻗어 읽을 수 있는 쐐기 윤곽을 이룬다. 부리와 목과 꼬리는 별도 소품이 아니라 한 새에 속한 종 식별 부위로 유지된다.

content.application_contract: Apply only when the independent scene declares one existing particular rigid sign board or chalkboard, a complete nonempty inscription and its physical attachment and local placement on that same board. Retain the complete exact character sequence, including spaces, punctuation, case, numeric leading zeros and distinct lines; retain the actual board type and every specified writing medium, lettering color, carrier color, position, ownership and illumination. Preserve handwriting when declared. Do not infer chalk from a chalkboard or choose an undeclared writing medium or color. A specified paint or chalk medium cannot be substituted. Do not change surface, words or line order, introduce a carrier, transfer external captions or speech, or infer operating state, route, currency or event history. Missing inscription, carrier or physical relation requires review; unspecified optional properties stay unspecified.
content.definition:
The already declared inscription retains its complete character sequence, case, spacing and line arrangement on the same declared rigid sign board, including a chalkboard when that is the declared board. Every stroke stays attached to its specified board face and local position, preserving the declared writing medium, stroke color and board color. Board edges and consistent perspective locate the full lettering on its physical carrier.
이미 선언된 문구는 동일하게 선언된 단단한 안내판 위에서 완전한 문자 순서, 대소문자, 간격과 줄 배열을 유지하며, 선언된 판이 칠판인 경우에는 바로 그 칠판을 지지체로 삼는다. 각 획은 지정된 판 면과 국소 위치에 붙어 있고, 선언된 필기 매체와 획의 색 및 판의 색을 유지한다. 판 가장자리와 일관된 원근은 실제 지지체 위에서 전체 문구의 위치를 드러낸다.
content.en: The already declared inscription retains its complete character sequence, case, spacing and line arrangement on the same declared rigid sign board, including a chalkboard when that is the declared board. Every stroke stays attached to its specified board face and local position, preserving the declared writing medium, stroke color and board color. Board edges and consistent perspective locate the full lettering on its physical carrier.
content.ko: 이미 선언된 문구는 동일하게 선언된 단단한 안내판 위에서 완전한 문자 순서, 대소문자, 간격과 줄 배열을 유지하며, 선언된 판이 칠판인 경우에는 바로 그 칠판을 지지체로 삼는다. 각 획은 지정된 판 면과 국소 위치에 붙어 있고, 선언된 필기 매체와 획의 색 및 판의 색을 유지한다. 판 가장자리와 일관된 원근은 실제 지지체 위에서 전체 문구의 위치를 드러낸다.

content.application_contract: Requires an existing adult, their actual face and an independently established hand-region inventory, and explicit older-looking declarations for those regions. Preserve each declared region and existing count; do not create an inventory. Every actual hand receiver retains the complete local age footprint. No specific wrinkles, skin-color change or new biological-age fact is added.
content.definition: One existing adult owns the existing face and hand regions; every named region retains its independently declared older-looking presentation.
content.en: The existing adult retains an explicitly older-looking face and older-looking skin on their already established hands. Each appearance stays on its own actual region of the same person; the facial assignment and the hand assignments remain distinct. The independently supplied chronological age is preserved separately, with no new hands, exact age estimate, health judgment or required surface-treatment history.
content.ko: 기존 성인은 명시적으로 나이 들어 보이는 얼굴과 이미 설정된 손들의 나이 들어 보이는 피부를 유지한다. 각 외양은 동일한 사람의 실제 해당 부위에 남으며 얼굴의 지정과 각 손의 지정은 서로 구분된다. 독립적으로 주어진 실제 연령은 별도로 유지되고 새 손, 정확한 나이 추정, 건강 판단 또는 필수적인 피부 처리 이력은 생기지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires an explicit same-subject language-history declaration; preserve stated owner, time and extent. Do not infer background from pixels or infer proficiency, nationality or ancestry from language. Does not request visible text, speech or costume.
content.definition: A supplied language-history statement is contextual information owned by the declared adult; its household/time scope and language-use versus ability distinctions are preserved.
content.en: The adult portrait subject's supplied biography records language use within a named household or period of life. Keep each stated language attached to that same person, household relation and time, distinguishing childhood exposure from current use and proficiency. This remains attributed personal context; neither a language name nor the subject's appearance supplies nationality, ancestry, accent, literacy or fluent speech. No writing, speaking action or cultural prop is added unless separately requested.
content.ko: 성인 인물사진 대상의 제공된 약력은 특정 가정이나 생애 시기의 언어 사용을 기록한다. 각 언어를 같은 사람과 해당 가정 관계 및 시기에 연결하고 어린 시절의 노출, 현재 사용, 숙련도를 구별한다. 이는 출처가 있는 개인 맥락으로 남으며 언어 이름이나 외모에서 국적·혈통·억양·문해력·유창한 발화를 채우지 않는다. 별도 요청이 없으면 글씨·말하는 행동·문화적 소품을 추가하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires an independently declared cat and selected existing hind limb. Applies only to the visible lower-hindlimb/hock/hindpaw route, not an unseen hip or whole skeleton. Preserve declared pose, count, overlaps and other limbs; this topology option does not expose bones, require a bend, establish health or infer locomotion.
content.definition: One declared feline hind limb owns its lower-leg, hock and hind-paw junctions; the selected paw is not a neighboring forepaw.
content.en: The selected hind limb of the declared cat remains one owned anatomical route. The lower hind-leg segment meets its own hock region and continues into that limb’s hind paw. Where the limb bends or overlaps another leg, the junctions retain the selected hind limb’s identity, with the hind paw traceable to that same leg.
content.ko: 선언된 고양이의 선택된 뒷다리는 한 주체에 속한 해부학적 경로로 유지된다. 아래쪽 뒷다리 분절은 자기 발목관절 부위에 이어지고 그 다리의 뒷발로 계속된다. 다리가 굽거나 다른 다리와 겹치는 곳에서도 연결부는 선택된 뒷다리의 정체성을 유지하며 뒷발을 같은 다리까지 따라갈 수 있다.

content.application_contract: The treatment belongs to the current photograph and its independently specified subjects and existing image regions. Preserve subject identity, count, material, structural detail required for recognition, any locked colors, and all required visible contextual evidence. Quieter appearance is photographic emphasis, not permission to remove objects, repaint surfaces, invent a blank wall, suppress required details or create an empty-world claim. No specific prop, architecture, process, monochrome conversion or historical affiliation is implied. All contour, interval, tonal-coherence and hierarchy relationships remain part of this option.
content.en: A minimalist photographic practice organizes the already specified subject and its existing surroundings through a few legible contour, spacing and tonal relationships. The subject’s recognizable outline is held apart from a quieter surrounding image field, and the interval between them carries deliberate visual weight. Broad color or gray-tone regions stay coherent, while differences needed to read the subject remain visible. Restrained photographic treatment keeps incidental texture subordinate to this connected form-and-space hierarchy.
content.ko: 미니멀 사진 관습은 이미 지정된 피사체와 그 기존 주변을 소수의 읽히는 윤곽·간격·계조 관계로 조직한다. 알아볼 수 있는 피사체 윤곽은 더 조용한 주변 화면 영역과 구별되며, 그 사이 간격이 의도적인 시각적 무게를 갖는다. 넓은 색 영역이나 회색 계조 영역은 일관성을 유지하고 피사체를 읽는 데 필요한 차이는 보이게 남는다. 절제된 사진 처리는 부수적 질감을 이처럼 연결된 형태와 공간의 위계보다 덜 두드러지게 한다.

content.application_contract: Use only for a declared folding stool with this crossing-leg construction. Preserve the actual seat panel and visible pivot ownership; a human crossed-leg pose is not a substitute. No person, folding action, lock state, carrying context, exact leg count, hidden fastener, material or load capacity is inferred.
content.definition: A folding stool has a bounded seat panel spanning the upper ends of its leg supports. On each visible side, crossing leg members remain distinct through their overlap, with a pivot joining them at the crossing. The seat attachment, supporting members and pivot are connected parts of the same stool, independently of any person sitting on it.
content.en: A folding stool has a bounded seat panel spanning the upper ends of its leg supports. On each visible side, crossing leg members remain distinct through their overlap, with a pivot joining them at the crossing. The seat attachment, supporting members and pivot are connected parts of the same stool, independently of any person sitting on it.
content.ko: 접이식 스툴에는 다리 지지부의 위쪽 끝 사이를 가로지르는 경계 있는 좌판이 있다. 보이는 각 측면에서 교차한 다리 부재가 겹침 구간에서도 구별되며, 교차점의 회전축이 두 부재를 연결한다. 좌판 부착부·지지 부재·회전축은 같은 스툴에 연결된 부품이며 사람이 앉아 있는지와는 별개다.

content.application_contract: Apply only when the independent scene declares one existing particular ceramic vessel, one complete nonempty inscription physically incised into that same vessel and its local placement. Preserve every exact character, space, punctuation mark, letter case, numeric leading zero and line arrangement; retain ceramic identity, incised medium, local position, ownership and every specified vessel form, surface color and illumination. A name in the inscription does not establish a person or owner identity. Do not introduce a vessel, choose a literal, substitute painted/printed marks, transfer a sign inscription, add color or manufacturing technology, infer historical ownership or incising time, or alter independently declared geometry. Missing inscription, vessel or physical relation requires review; unspecified optional properties stay unspecified.
content.definition:
The already declared inscription retains its complete character sequence, case, spacing and line arrangement on the same declared ceramic vessel. Its incised characters remain narrow recessed strokes attached to the specified curved ceramic face and local position. The vessel rim or body contour locates the full inscription on that physical carrier, while all declared surface colors, geometry and illumination remain unchanged.
이미 선언된 문구는 동일하게 선언된 도자기 용기 위에서 완전한 문자 순서, 대소문자, 간격과 줄 배열을 유지한다. 새겨진 문자는 지정된 도자기 곡면과 국소 위치에 붙은 좁게 파인 획으로 남는다. 용기의 테두리 또는 몸체 윤곽은 실제 지지체 위 전체 문구의 위치를 특정하며, 선언된 모든 표면 색과 기하 형태 및 조명은 바뀌지 않는다.
content.en: The already declared inscription retains its complete character sequence, case, spacing and line arrangement on the same declared ceramic vessel. Its incised characters remain narrow recessed strokes attached to the specified curved ceramic face and local position. The vessel rim or body contour locates the full inscription on that physical carrier, while all declared surface colors, geometry and illumination remain unchanged.
content.ko: 이미 선언된 문구는 동일하게 선언된 도자기 용기 위에서 완전한 문자 순서, 대소문자, 간격과 줄 배열을 유지한다. 새겨진 문자는 지정된 도자기 곡면과 국소 위치에 붙은 좁게 파인 획으로 남는다. 용기의 테두리 또는 몸체 윤곽은 실제 지지체 위 전체 문구의 위치를 특정하며, 선언된 모든 표면 색과 기하 형태 및 조명은 바뀌지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires explicit same-subject residence and timing; retain exactly the supplied interval/duration. Do not infer a birthplace, origin, legal status, second residence or current continuation from the place, photograph or elapsed time.
content.definition: One explicitly supplied adult-person residence relation, with the stated interval or duration, remains contextual and independent of personal origin or multiple life stages.
content.en: The adult portrait subject's supplied biography states that the person lived in a particular place during a stated period or for a stated duration. Preserve that one residence relation with its own timing, without requiring a birthplace, a childhood home or a second place. Residence remains an attributed biographical context, not proof of nationality, citizenship, ancestry or continuing present residence. The photograph's setting and visible features do not establish the interval or add another stage of life.
content.ko: 성인 인물사진 대상의 제공된 약력은 그 사람이 특정 기간 동안 또는 일정한 기간 길이만큼 특정 장소에서 살았다고 명시한다. 출생지·어린 시절 고향·두 번째 장소를 요구하지 않고 그 하나의 거주 관계와 시기를 보존한다. 거주는 출처가 있는 전기적 맥락으로 남으며 국적·시민권·혈통·현재까지 이어지는 거주를 입증하지 않는다. 사진의 배경과 외모는 해당 기간을 입증하거나 다른 생애 시기를 추가하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires an independently present loose textile and supporting surface with a declared edge. Keep the same cloth, surface and owners. Placement and resulting drape must be open; preserve locked weave, color, state and support orientation. A worn scarf, garment hem, dangling fringe, frame crop or narrative trailing cloth is not this contact topology.
content.definition: One already declared loose textile extends continuously from a supported region across the visible boundary of its existing support. The section on top remains in contact with that support, and the same cloth turns downward beyond the edge into a freely hanging section. The edge separates these two regions without cutting the textile into separate objects. This arrangement concerns the loose textile and its support, without assigning a wearer or a narrative event.
content.en: One already declared loose textile extends continuously from a supported region across the visible boundary of its existing support. The section on top remains in contact with that support, and the same cloth turns downward beyond the edge into a freely hanging section. The edge separates these two regions without cutting the textile into separate objects. This arrangement concerns the loose textile and its support, without assigning a wearer or a narrative event.
content.ko: 이미 선언된 느슨한 직물 하나가 받쳐진 영역에서 기존 받침의 보이는 경계를 넘어 연속해서 이어진다. 위쪽 구간은 받침과 접촉한 채 있고 같은 천은 가장자리 밖에서 아래로 꺾여 자유롭게 늘어진 구간이 된다. 가장자리는 두 영역을 구별하지만 직물을 서로 다른 물건으로 나누지 않는다. 이 배치는 느슨한 직물과 받침에 관한 것으로 착용자나 서사적 사건을 부여하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires an independently declared person, facial skin region and positive physical cosmetic decal/applique design. Preserve all declared shape, color, finish, arrangement, medium, size and wearer restrictions. Do not invent an undeclared motif or move a fixed source design, reinterpret garment ornaments or title/card text as applied skin decoration, replace crystals/foil/paint with decals, or override an explicit bare-skin/excluded-decoration instruction. No specific motif, reflective finish or region is selected by this source itself.
content.definition: A removable applied cosmetic decal/applique design owned by the independently declared facial skin region, with all supplied design traits and wearer preserved.
content.en: Removable cosmetic decals or appliqués form the independently declared decorative design directly on the selected person's explicitly specified facial skin region. Each thin attached piece has a readable boundary against the skin beneath it. Every declared shape, finish, color, arrangement and location remains the scene's supplied choice. Uncovered skin between or around the pieces distinguishes the applied cosmetic decoration from garment trim, a permanent marking or a printed title.
content.ko: 떼어낼 수 있는 화장용 데칼이나 아플리케가 선택된 사람의 명시적으로 지정된 얼굴 피부 부위에 독립적으로 선언된 장식 디자인을 직접 이룬다. 얇게 붙인 각 조각에는 아래 피부와 구분되는 경계가 보인다. 선언된 모든 형태, 표면 마감, 색, 배치와 위치는 장면이 제공한 선택 그대로 유지된다. 조각 사이나 주변의 드러난 피부가 이 붙인 화장 장식을 의복 장식, 영구 표식 또는 인쇄된 제목과 구분한다.

content.application_contract: Apply only when the independent scene declares one existing particular luminous physical sign or numeric display, one complete nonempty inscription and attachment and local placement on that same actual carrier. Preserve each exact character, space, punctuation mark, case, numeric leading zero, separator and line arrangement; retain actual carrier type, ownership, mounting position and every specified emitting medium, lettering/carrier color and illumination property. Neon tubing, LED segments and pixel displays are not interchangeable when declared; unspecified emitting technology or color remains unspecified and is never inferred from glow. Do not replace a sign with a scoreboard, add a carrier, select a literal or technology, move an entrance sign into a window, transfer an external caption or speech, or infer quantity, event history, elapsed time or business operation from characters. Missing inscription, carrier or physical relation requires review.
content.definition:
The already declared inscription retains its complete character sequence, case, spacing and line arrangement on the same declared luminous physical sign or numeric display. The actual carrier and its local mounting position stay unchanged, with the entire inscription attached inside its boundary. Character strokes retain every declared emitting medium, color and illumination property; local glow keeps their shapes legible without replacing the specified technology or character arrangement.
이미 선언된 문구는 동일하게 선언된 실제 발광 간판 또는 숫자 표시장치 위에서 완전한 문자 순서, 대소문자, 간격과 줄 배열을 유지한다. 실제 지지체와 그 국소 장착 위치는 바뀌지 않고, 전체 문구는 해당 지지체의 경계 안에 붙어 있다. 문자 획은 선언된 모든 발광 매체와 색 및 조명 속성을 유지하며, 국소적인 빛 번짐 속에서도 형태가 읽히고 지정된 기술이나 문자 배열을 바꾸지 않는다.
content.en: The already declared inscription retains its complete character sequence, case, spacing and line arrangement on the same declared luminous physical sign or numeric display. The actual carrier and its local mounting position stay unchanged, with the entire inscription attached inside its boundary. Character strokes retain every declared emitting medium, color and illumination property; local glow keeps their shapes legible without replacing the specified technology or character arrangement.
