content.application_contract: Use only for the independently declared adult butterfly animal owner with all named parts on that same body. Keep existing color, pattern, pose and scene; choose a view where the actual roots and specified contours are readable. A quoted name, motif, neighboring animal or costume does not declare the owner. No flight action, emotion, transformation, medical state or additional animal is inferred.
content.definition: On the declared butterfly, two slender antennae emerge from its own head and end in small club-like swellings. The wings meet the thorax of that same insect at readable bases, while the head and thorax remain connected. Antenna roots, swollen tips and wing roots belong to one living butterfly rather than separate ornaments or a wearable wing frame.
content.en: On the declared butterfly, two slender antennae emerge from its own head and end in small club-like swellings. The wings meet the thorax of that same insect at readable bases, while the head and thorax remain connected. Antenna roots, swollen tips and wing roots belong to one living butterfly rather than separate ornaments or a wearable wing frame.
content.ko: 선언된 나비의 머리에서 가는 더듬이 두 개가 나오고 끝에는 작은 곤봉 모양의 부푼 부분이 있다. 날개는 같은 곤충의 가슴에 읽을 수 있는 밑동으로 이어지며 머리와 가슴의 연결도 유지된다. 더듬이 뿌리와 부푼 끝과 날개 뿌리는 별도 장식이나 착용형 날개 프레임이 아니라 하나의 살아 있는 나비에 속한다.

content.application_contract: Requires an independently declared human anatomical diagram and its existing depicted upper limb. Applies only to the represented wrist and adjacent forearm/hand endpoints; retain the diagram carrier, view and drawing medium already declared. It does not create a person, change a real reader's hand, impose X-ray appearance, reveal a hidden full limb or infer diagnosis. A generic line join, human hand gesture or feline radiograph cannot substitute.
content.definition: The declared anatomical illustration owns one represented human forearm/wrist/hand connection. The bounded print or panel is its carrier, and the represented anatomy has no attachment to a reader's live hand.
content.en: Inside the already declared human anatomical diagram, the represented forearm meets the represented wrist, and that wrist joins the base of the same illustrated hand. The connected outlines and joint region belong to one depicted upper limb within the bounded diagram. The photographic page or panel carries this anatomical relation while any real person beside it retains an independent body.
content.ko: 이미 선언된 사람 해부도 안에서 묘사된 아래팔은 묘사된 손목과 만나고 그 손목은 같은 그림 속 손의 기저부로 이어진다. 이어진 윤곽과 관절 부위는 경계가 있는 해부도 안의 하나의 묘사된 팔에 속한다. 사진에 찍힌 페이지나 패널이 이 해부학적 관계를 담고 그 옆의 실제 사람은 독립된 신체를 유지한다.

content.application_contract: Requires the same established adult, their face, and both independently established hands. Preserve older-looking on the face and youthful-looking on each hand. All three regional age effects belong to the complete selection; do not transfer a value, omit a hand, add an anatomical inventory or infer chronological age.
content.definition: One existing adult owns the face and both separately established hands; face is older-looking and each hand is youthful-looking.
content.en: One existing adult has an explicitly older-looking facial appearance while the skin on both of their already established hands has an explicitly youthful-looking appearance. These contrasting values remain local to the face and to each hand, all owned by the same person. Their declared adult age remains separate, and neither a second person nor a biological explanation follows from the contrast.
content.ko: 기존 성인 한 명의 얼굴은 명시적으로 나이 들어 보이는 외양이고 이미 설정된 양손의 피부는 명시적으로 젊어 보이는 외양이다. 서로 다른 이 값들은 모두 동일한 사람에게 속하는 얼굴과 각 손에 국소적으로 남는다. 명시된 성인 연령은 별도로 유지되며 이 대비로 두 번째 사람이나 생물학적 설명이 생기지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires an existing human adult and their actual facial skin. Preserve chronological-age prerequisites and all other regions. The complete selection also changes local skin smoothness and facial fullness; all three footprints must remain permitted.
content.definition: The selected face belongs to the already established adult, and only that face receives youthful-looking skin presentation.
content.en: The already established adult’s own facial skin has an explicitly youthful-looking presentation, with a comparatively smooth surface and softly full facial contours. This appearance remains local to that face. Their independently declared age and adult identity are preserved; hands and other regions receive no age appearance from this selection, and no cosmetic treatment, health state or biography is implied.
content.ko: 이미 설정된 성인 자신의 얼굴 피부는 비교적 매끈한 표면과 부드럽게 도톰한 얼굴 윤곽으로 명시적으로 젊어 보이는 인상을 띤다. 이 외양은 해당 얼굴에만 한정된다. 독립적으로 명시된 연령과 성인 정체성은 유지되며 이 선택은 손과 다른 부위에 연령 인상을 부여하지 않고 미용 시술, 건강 상태 또는 삶의 이력을 뜻하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Use only for a declared hard equipment case with a hinged lid and visibly evidenced interior receiving cavities. Preserve the actual lid/base and recess ownership; current open state alone is insufficient. Do not infer whether cavities are molded into the shell or provided by an insert. Do not impose a disc recess, transparent shell, contents, exact cavity count, foam chemistry, manufacture, protection rating or damage/readiness state.
content.definition: A hard equipment case has a separately bounded lid and base connected along a visible hinge line. Shaped receiving cavities occupy the interior of the base, with their edges distinct from the surrounding interior surface and outer case walls. The lid connection, base shell and internal recesses belong to the same case assembly rather than to loose contents.
content.en: A hard equipment case has a separately bounded lid and base connected along a visible hinge line. Shaped receiving cavities occupy the interior of the base, with their edges distinct from the surrounding interior surface and outer case walls. The lid connection, base shell and internal recesses belong to the same case assembly rather than to loose contents.
content.ko: 장비용 하드 케이스에는 경계가 구별되는 뚜껑과 본체가 있으며 보이는 경첩선을 따라 연결된다. 형태가 있는 수납 홈들이 본체 내부에 있고, 그 가장자리는 주변 내부 표면 및 케이스 외벽과 구별된다. 뚜껑 연결부·본체 껍질·내부 홈은 느슨한 내용물이 아니라 같은 케이스 조립체에 속한다.

content.application_contract: Use animal_subject and main_subject only as independently declared existing disjoint participants mapped to their actual source owners. Require the independently supplied companion relation from this animal to this exact primary; proximity does not establish it. Preserve all participants, count, species, appearance, actions and primary identity. No animal, human, body part, legal ownership, affection or permission is inferred. This maintenance proposal remains discovery-only pending native semantic and owner admission review; all actual effects and requester locks require independent checking. Require an existing bird, human primary, existing primary_shoulder as part of that same human, and an independently declared bird-perched-on-that-shoulder scene with compatible established scale and contact. Preserve primary pose and bird action. Do not invent anatomy, resize the bird, create a shoulder perch or turn this descriptive source into handling instructions. RSPCA discourages shoulder carrying; this record is not evidence of safety, trust or welfare and supplies no staging recommendation.
content.definition: A declared companion bird is physically supported at its own feet by the independently declared shoulder belonging to its identified human primary, with both body owners retained.
content.en: A separately declared companion bird remains perched on the already specified shoulder of its identified human primary subject. The bird’s feet meet that same shoulder surface, with its body supported above the contact and distinct from the person’s head and clothing. This owned support relation makes the supplied bird–person accompaniment readable while preserving the bird’s declared species, size, count and existing perched state.
content.ko: 별도로 선언된 동반 새가 식별된 인간 주 대상의 이미 지정된 어깨 위에 앉아 있는 상태를 유지한다. 새의 발은 바로 그 어깨 표면에 닿고 몸은 접촉 지점 위에서 지지되며 사람의 머리 및 옷과 구별된다. 소유자가 명확한 이 지지 관계는 새의 선언된 종, 크기, 수와 기존에 앉아 있는 상태를 보존하면서 제공된 새와 사람의 동반 관계를 읽을 수 있게 한다.

content.application_contract: Use only for an independently declared actual domestic-cat entity. Preserve independently declared principal-versus-companion hierarchy. Do not infer a person, breed, coat, stray or pet status, pose, full-body visibility, tail form or entity count; named visible structures do not require every body part to be shown.
content.definition: The independently declared domestic cat owns its joined visible external body structures; visible paws and limbs retain correspondence to that same animal.
content.en: A declared domestic cat is a recognizable animal whose head and flexible trunk join its limbs at the same body. The face carries external ears and muzzle whiskers, while visible paws terminate the corresponding limbs. Coat color, hair length and breed remain those independently chosen for this cat. These structures identify the animal itself; they do not establish a human handler, companion relation, housing status or represented animal inside an image.
content.ko: 선언된 집고양이는 머리와 유연한 몸통이 같은 몸의 다리들과 연결되는 알아볼 수 있는 동물이다. 얼굴에는 외부 귀와 주둥이 수염이 있고 보이는 발은 해당 다리의 끝에 이어진다. 털 색·길이·품종은 이 고양이에 대해 독립적으로 선택된 상태로 남는다. 이 구조는 동물 자체를 식별하며 사람 조련자·동반 관계·거주 상태나 이미지 속에 묘사된 동물을 성립시키지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Use animal_subject and main_subject only as independently declared existing disjoint participants mapped to their actual source owners. Require the independently supplied companion relation from this animal to this exact primary; proximity does not establish it. Preserve all participants, count, species, appearance, actions and primary identity. No animal, human, body part, legal ownership, affection or permission is inferred. This maintenance proposal remains discovery-only pending native semantic and owner admission review; all actual effects and requester locks require independent checking. Develop only the animal-owned accompanying position. Retain declared contact or lack of contact, current locomotion or rest, separate support ownership and current scene. Do not borrow human anatomy or require a lap, shoulder, walking gait, leash, grooming or gaze.
content.definition: One independently declared animal accompanies one identified independently declared primary through beside-primary placement; the primary may be human or nonhuman and each existing action and support is retained.
content.en: An existing animal companion is positioned beside its separately declared primary counterpart in their shared scene. The two bodies remain visually distinct, and each keeps its established activity and support. Their accompanying placement is readable through the animal’s location relative to that particular primary subject. No physical touch, human primary, new animal species or change of action is required by this arrangement.
content.ko: 기존 동물 동반자가 함께 있는 장면에서 별도로 선언된 주 대상의 곁에 배치된다. 두 몸은 눈에 보이게 구별되며 각각 이미 정해진 활동과 받침을 유지한다. 동물이 바로 그 주 대상에 대해 놓인 위치를 통해 동반 배치가 읽힌다. 이 배치는 신체 접촉, 인간 주 대상, 새로운 동물 종 또는 동작 변경을 요구하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires an independently identified adult and explicit chronological-age declaration. Preserve exactly that declaration as a prerequisite. This record has no appearance or age mutation effect and cannot stand in for an independently requested local age appearance.
content.definition: The existing adult is the sole owner of the independently supplied chronological-age declaration.
content.en: An already identified adult retains the chronological age explicitly supplied by the independent scene. That declaration belongs to that person and remains contextual information, even when no visible age treatment is selected. It supplies no wrinkles, smoothness, hair color, health, family role or regional age appearance, and no numerical age is estimated from the photograph.
content.ko: 이미 식별된 성인은 독립적인 장면에 명시적으로 주어진 실제 연령을 유지한다. 그 선언은 해당 인물에게 속하며 보이는 연령 처리가 선택되지 않은 경우에도 문맥 정보로 남는다. 이 선언은 주름, 매끈함, 머리색, 건강, 가족 역할 또는 국소 연령 외양을 부여하지 않으며 사진에서 수치 연령을 추정하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires at least one existing stable upright or level scene reference and an independently declared capture target. The clockwise convention applies to camera rotation viewed from behind, not the sign of an image-editing rotation control. No exact angle or emotional meaning is required. Body lean, a diagonal prop, oblique viewing yaw, camera pitch, a quoted technique label, and a camera depicted in the scene cannot substitute. Do not rotate the subject or architecture or infer physical camera history from pixels.
content.definition: Clockwise roll belongs to the capture camera around its existing viewing axis under the explicit behind-camera operator convention, and scene reference lines show a slanted frame relation.
content.en: The taking camera is rolled clockwise about its viewing axis, with clockwise defined from the operator’s position behind the camera looking toward the subject. Stable upright or level references already present in the scene consequently appear slanted relative to the image borders. The axis still points at the same target; the subject, room geometry and their own orientations remain intact.
content.ko: 촬영 카메라는 관찰축을 중심으로 시계 방향으로 회전하며, 시계 방향은 카메라 뒤에서 피사체를 바라보는 촬영자의 위치를 기준으로 정의한다. 이에 따라 장면에 이미 있는 안정된 수직 또는 수평 기준선이 이미지 테두리에 비해 비스듬하게 보인다. 관찰축은 계속 같은 대상을 향하고, 피사체와 방의 기하 및 각각의 방향은 그대로 보존한다.

content.application_contract: Requires two independently identified existing adults and an explicit owner-specific older-looking versus youthful-looking declaration. Resolve both named owners from the independent scene. Preserve the stated assignment and all chronological-age prerequisites; no position, count, occupation, local skin treatment or family relationship is invented.
content.definition: Two distinct existing adult owners retain their individually declared older-looking and youthful-looking whole-person presentations.
content.en: Two already identified adults retain separate whole-person age appearances explicitly assigned in the independent scene: one is older-looking and the other is youthful-looking. Each appearance follows its named person through the photograph, without moving between people or becoming a contrast between body parts. Their adult identities and any independently supplied chronological ages remain unchanged; no kinship, occupation, new person or exact age estimate is introduced.
content.ko: 이미 식별된 두 성인은 독립적인 장면에서 명시적으로 지정된 서로 다른 전신 연령 외양을 유지한다. 한 사람은 나이 들어 보이고 다른 사람은 젊어 보인다. 각 외양은 사진에서 지정된 인물을 따르며 사람 사이로 이동하거나 신체 부위 간 대비로 바뀌지 않는다. 성인 정체성과 독립적으로 주어진 실제 연령은 그대로 남고 가족 관계, 직업, 새 인물 또는 정확한 나이 추정은 생기지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Apply only to the already declared human eye when this local property is open. Preserve existing iris color, left/right assignment, pupil shape, eye count, gaze, expression and surrounding cosmetics. Do not transfer printed-chart eyes, quoted text or editorial metaphors to the actor. Depicted texture or outline establishes no diagnosis, age, ancestry, personality, biometric identity, contact lens or physical cause.
content.definition: An owned local appearance relation on the already declared human actor’s actual iris; the selected texture or outline stays on that same eye.
content.en: A thin dark outline follows the visible outer edge of the already declared human subject’s iris, separating its colored region from the adjacent eye white. The outline remains peripheral to the iris rather than tracing the eyelid. Inside it, the established iris color and central pupil remain separately readable within the same eye.
content.ko: 이미 선언된 사람 피사체의 홍채에서 가는 어두운 윤곽이 보이는 바깥 가장자리를 따라가며 유색 영역과 인접한 흰자위를 구분한다. 이 윤곽은 눈꺼풀을 따라가지 않고 홍채의 주변부에 놓인다. 그 안에서는 기존 홍채 색과 중앙 동공이 같은 눈 안의 별도 영역으로 읽힌다.

content.application_contract: Requires an independently existing selected object with an identified upright planar front surface. Apply only to the taking camera, preserving the object’s geometry and orientation. A depicted camera, gaze, front-facing camera hardware, front flash direction, quoted title, or height label cannot supply this relation. Do not create a face, photobooth, cabinet, object turn, camera location or lens setting. Image geometry alone cannot prove exact pose calibration.
content.definition: The taking camera has horizontal pitch, frontal yaw relative to the selected existing upright front, and level roll.
content.en: The capture camera faces the selected existing object’s front surface squarely, so the viewing axis is normal to that surface rather than aimed across its side corner. Its optical axis is horizontal and its frame roll is level. The same front remains the reference throughout; object rotation, camera height and camera distance remain separate choices.
content.ko: 촬영 카메라는 선택한 기존 물체의 앞면을 곧바로 마주 보며, 관찰축은 옆 모서리를 비껴 향하는 대신 그 앞면에 수직이다. 광축은 수평이고 프레임의 롤도 수평을 유지한다. 전체에서 같은 앞면을 기준으로 삼으며 물체의 회전, 카메라 높이와 거리는 별도 선택으로 남는다.

content.application_contract: Apply only to independently specified existing scene subjects and their already present recurring forms. Preserve identity, count, construction, required arrangement, material, colors and contextual evidence. Viewpoint and photographic tonal emphasis may develop only where open. Do not invent modules, architectural stairs, new props or repeated copies of a subject, flatten physical volumes into a graphic artifact, or infer artist/institution/history membership. Recurring contours, directional rhythm, picture-edge relationships and retained volume are cumulative components of this photographic option.
content.en: A geometric modernist photographic practice makes the existing scene’s recurring contours and directional relationships carry the image. A selected viewpoint aligns parallel runs and related curves into a legible rhythm, with distances to the picture edges completing the construction. Tonal separation keeps adjacent forms distinct, while shading preserves their real volume. The photograph remains a view of the specified subjects, and its formal coherence comes from relationships among their visible structures rather than added geometric props.
content.ko: 기하학적 모더니즘 사진 관습은 기존 장면에서 되풀이되는 윤곽과 방향 관계가 화면을 이끌게 한다. 선택한 시점이 평행하게 이어지는 선과 서로 관계된 곡선을 읽히는 리듬으로 맞추며, 화면 가장자리까지의 거리가 그 구성을 완성한다. 명도 분리는 인접 형태를 구별하고 음영은 실제 입체감을 유지한다. 사진은 지정된 피사체를 바라보는 장면으로 남으며, 그 조형적 일관성은 새로 더한 기하학적 소품이 아니라 보이는 구조들 사이의 관계에서 나온다.

content.application_contract: Require two independently established visible owners and a readable interval between them. Preserve the declared affect only as context; actual pose, count, action, setting and support stay authoritative. Do not replace standing with sitting, a bench with a chair/table, or unoccupied space with an inferred former occupant. Without an independently declared emotional reading this is spatial advice, not automatic sadness, tension or serenity.
content.definition: Two independently established scene elements remain visibly separate, with both boundaries and the intervening space readable in one frame. Their current pose, action, support and location remain intact. The requested emotional atmosphere belongs to the scene-level interpretation of that interval; the gap does not itself prove loneliness, conflict, a relationship history or anyone’s private feeling. No absent participant, furnishing or event is added to explain the space.
content.en: Two independently established scene elements remain visibly separate, with both boundaries and the intervening space readable in one frame. Their current pose, action, support and location remain intact. The requested emotional atmosphere belongs to the scene-level interpretation of that interval; the gap does not itself prove loneliness, conflict, a relationship history or anyone’s private feeling. No absent participant, furnishing or event is added to explain the space.
content.ko: 독립적으로 설정된 장면 요소 둘이 눈에 보이게 떨어져 있으며 두 경계와 그 사이 공간을 한 프레임에서 읽을 수 있다. 기존 자세·행동·받침·장소를 유지한다. 요청된 정서적 분위기는 그 간격에 대한 장면 차원의 해석에 속하며, 간격 자체가 외로움·갈등·관계의 역사나 누군가의 내면 감정을 입증하지 않는다. 공간을 설명하려고 부재한 참가자·가구·사건을 추가하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires exactly the independently present prop, two independently named actors and their existing ground surface. Preserve actor identities, posture and count, prop ownership and state. The source changes only prop placement; it does not make either actor hold it, add another prop, create a barrier or assign emotional distance. Both named reference actors must be independently available.
content.definition: A single existing prop rests on its base on the already declared ground surface in the gap between two named actors. A visible ground contact supports the object; the two actor positions bound its placement from opposite sides. The prop belongs to its existing owner and remains separate from both actors’ hands. Neither a picture-space overlap of faces nor a story about emotional distance supplies this physical ground-and-between relationship.
content.en: A single existing prop rests on its base on the already declared ground surface in the gap between two named actors. A visible ground contact supports the object; the two actor positions bound its placement from opposite sides. The prop belongs to its existing owner and remains separate from both actors’ hands. Neither a picture-space overlap of faces nor a story about emotional distance supplies this physical ground-and-between relationship.
content.ko: 기존 소품 하나의 밑면이 두 지정된 인물 사이의 틈에서 이미 선언된 지면에 닿아 놓인다. 보이는 지면 접촉이 물체를 받치며 두 인물의 위치가 반대편에서 소품 위치의 경계를 이룬다. 소품은 기존 소유자에게 속하고 양쪽 인물의 손과 분리되어 있다. 화면에서 얼굴이 겹치는 구도나 감정적 거리에 관한 이야기는 이 실제 지면 및 사이 배치 관계를 대신하지 못한다.

content.application_contract: Requires an explicit same-subject self-identification. Preserve the stated term and source; do not turn cultural affiliation into genetic descent, or infer it from clothing, appearance, location or another person. No cultural styling is authorized by the declaration alone.
content.definition: The declared adult owns the supplied cultural self-identification; affiliation, descent and national/legal status remain distinct unless each is independently supplied.
content.en: The adult portrait subject explicitly identifies with one or more cultural communities in the supplied biography. Preserve the person's stated affiliation and its source without replacing it with a claim of birthplace, citizenship or genealogical descent. A supplied heritage label keeps its stated meaning; an unclear distinction remains unresolved. This contextual self-identification does not prescribe facial traits, personality, ceremonial clothing, symbols or participation in restricted practices, and the portrait supplies no independent verification of the declaration.
content.ko: 성인 인물사진 대상이 제공된 약력에서 하나 이상의 문화 공동체와 자신을 명시적으로 연결한다. 본인이 밝힌 소속과 그 출처를 유지하며 출생지·시민권·계보적 혈통 진술로 바꾸지 않는다. 제공된 문화적 유산 표지는 명시된 의미로 보존하고 구분이 불분명하면 미해결로 둔다. 이 맥락적 자기 정체성 진술은 얼굴 특징·성격·의례복·상징·제한된 관습 참여를 지정하지 않으며 인물사진은 해당 선언을 독립적으로 검증하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Apply only to the already declared human eye when this local property is open. Preserve existing iris color, left/right assignment, pupil shape, eye count, gaze, expression and surrounding cosmetics. Do not transfer printed-chart eyes, quoted text or editorial metaphors to the actor. Depicted texture or outline establishes no diagnosis, age, ancestry, personality, biometric identity, contact lens or physical cause.
content.definition: An owned local appearance relation on the already declared human actor’s actual iris; the selected texture or outline stays on that same eye.
content.en: Fine uneven streaks extend outward across the already declared human subject’s iris from the pupil region. Small branches and differences in spacing keep the visible texture irregular rather than a repeated printed pattern. The established iris color remains visible between the streaks, and the central pupil stays a separate opening within that same eye.
content.ko: 이미 선언된 사람 피사체의 홍채에서 가늘고 불규칙한 줄무늬가 동공 부근에서 바깥쪽으로 뻗는다. 작은 가지와 서로 다른 간격 때문에 보이는 질감은 반복 인쇄 무늬 대신 불규칙하게 읽힌다. 줄무늬 사이로 기존 홍채 색이 보이고 같은 눈 안의 중앙 동공은 별도의 구멍으로 남는다.

content.application_contract: Apply photographic treatment only to the independently specified subject. Preserve identity, count, material, arrangement and factual context. No particular plant, machine, historical photographer, capture apparatus, darkroom process, monochrome palette or documentary truth is established. Sharp detail alone does not prove movement membership; all visible structural and tonal relationships remain part of this authored option.
content.en: A straight-photographic treatment describes the existing subject through precise edges, readable surface detail and coherent near-to-far clarity. Deliberate framing lets its real contours and internal structures organize the picture, while separated tonal values preserve volume and the relation between adjacent surfaces. The resulting visual practice places exact photographic description and formal organization in the same image; detail serves the subject’s structure rather than functioning as a generic sharpness slogan.
content.ko: 스트레이트 사진 처리는 기존 피사체를 정밀한 가장자리, 읽을 수 있는 표면 세부, 앞뒤로 일관된 명료함으로 묘사한다. 신중한 프레이밍이 실제 윤곽과 내부 구조로 화면을 조직하고, 분리된 계조가 입체감과 인접 표면 사이의 관계를 유지한다. 이 시각적 관습은 정확한 사진적 묘사와 조형적 조직을 한 이미지에 놓으며, 디테일은 일반적인 선명함 구호가 아니라 피사체 구조에 기여한다.

content.application_contract: Use for an independently declared living olive-tree subject with a mature twisted-trunk variant allowed. A title, inscription, olive color or image of a tree does not declare the organism. No fruit, flowers, exact age, giant size, location, extra plant or entity count is inferred.
content.definition: The living olive tree owns its joined trunk, branches and attached leaves; surrounding plants and surfaces are independent owners.
content.en: A declared olive tree has a continuous woody trunk that divides into branches carrying narrow leathery leaves. In this mature variant, the trunk is visibly twisted and the branches form an open crown. Trunk, branches and leaves belong to the same living plant; neighboring ground and other plants remain separate scene owners. The recognizable plant is the subject rather than a word, color name or representation of a tree.
content.ko: 선언된 올리브나무는 좁고 질긴 잎을 단 가지들로 갈라지는 연속된 목질 줄기를 가진다. 이 성숙한 개체의 실현에서는 줄기가 눈에 띄게 비틀리고 가지들은 열린 수관을 이룬다. 줄기·가지·잎은 같은 살아 있는 식물에 속하며 주변 땅과 다른 식물은 별도의 장면 소유자로 남는다. 알아볼 수 있는 식물 자체가 피사체이며 나무를 가리키는 단어나 색 이름 또는 재현물이 피사체를 대신하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Apply only where a series and its specimen subjects are independently declared. Do not create extra photographs, subjects, an industrial site, a grid layout or a black-and-white conversion from this advisory source. A single photograph may borrow frontal descriptive treatment but cannot alone establish the comparative typology.
content.en: In an independently declared photographic series, a typological treatment gives each existing specimen a consistent frontal presentation and comparable picture scale. Restrained backgrounds and even descriptive light keep structural differences legible across the images. The shared treatment makes differences in silhouette, construction and function comparable while preserving each specimen’s individual detail. The aesthetic belongs to the relationship among photographs, rather than repeated objects inside one frame.
content.ko: 독립적으로 선언된 사진 연작에서 유형학적 처리는 기존의 각 표본을 일관된 정면과 비교 가능한 화면 크기로 제시한다. 절제된 배경과 고른 묘사광이 사진 사이의 구조 차이를 읽히게 한다. 공통된 처리는 각 표본의 개별 세부를 유지하면서 윤곽·구조·기능의 차이를 비교할 수 있게 한다. 이 미학은 한 프레임 안의 물체 반복이 아니라 사진들 사이의 관계에 속한다.

content.application_contract: Requires the existing selected structure and an actual underside visible along the proposed sightline. Do not create a bridge, support pier, upright, overhang, enlarged base, sky or person. Preserve structure geometry, location, camera distance, and any independently chosen roll. Below-subject placement alone is not upward-axis proof; reflected, displayed or verbally declared lower surfaces do not become actual structure surfaces. No exact physical camera pose or capture history is proven.
content.definition: The capture-camera axis points upward at the independently existing structure underside and makes that same underside visible.
content.en: The taking camera’s optical axis rises above the horizontal toward the actual lower surface of an existing elevated structure. That underside remains a readable plane bounded by the structure’s existing edges. The upward aim and the lower-surface target belong to the same capture view; no particular camera height, foreground enlargement, vertical convergence or roll is required.
content.ko: 촬영 카메라의 광축은 수평선보다 위로 향하여 기존의 높이 놓인 구조물의 실제 아랫면을 바라본다. 그 아랫면은 구조물의 기존 가장자리로 둘러싸인 읽을 수 있는 면으로 남는다. 위를 향하는 광축과 아랫면이라는 대상은 같은 촬영 시점에 속하며, 특정 카메라 높이, 전경 확대, 수직선 수렴이나 롤을 요구하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Apply only where the independent scene already establishes a synthetic figure and its humanlike face. Preserve its existing material, identity and all other regions. Portrayed age is neither biological age nor manufacture age and supplies no exemption from any independent human/adult restriction.
content.definition: The selected humanlike facial surface is an actual owned region of an existing synthetic figure; middle-aged-looking is a local representational appearance.

content.application_contract: Use only with an independently declared existing liquid mass already resting on its independently declared support, with its macroscopic contour open for development. content.definition: A broad shallow contour belongs to one existing supported liquid mass; the continuous material perimeter is distinct from a vessel rim, reflected light pool or stain.
content.en: The existing liquid mass spreads into a broad, shallow body whose footprint is wider than its height. A low rounded side profile joins an irregular but continuous outer perimeter. The central expanse and the gently projecting edge regions remain one connected volume on the already declared support.

content.en: Apply the independently specified macroscopic contour to its already declared non-anatomical liquid, deformable mass or transient material body. The bounded volume keeps the requested continuity, extent and number of connected regions on that same physical carrier. Every declared support, contact and phase remains attached to its existing owner while the material body expresses the supplied shape.
